The <b>Shard Pendant</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It increases [[Shell Shard]] drops from defeated enemies.

== Usefulness ==
Equipping the Shard Pendant increases the number of [[Shell Shard]]s dropped by enemies by 25%,<ref name=percentage>In <code>globalsettings_assets_all.bundle</code>, check <code>Global Gameplay Settings</code>'s field <code>boneNecklaceShellshardIncrease</code>, or check <code>GlobalSettings.Gameplay.BoneNecklaceShellshardIncrease</code> in-game.</ref> rounded up to the nearest whole number.<ref><code>HealthManager.Die()</code>.</ref> It does not increase the number of Shell Shards gained from other sources, such as Shell Shard deposits and [[Shard Bundle]]s.

It pairs well with the [[Architect Crest]] due to that Crest's focus on the use of {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}.

== How to Acquire ==
Found in [[the Marrow]], in a side room off the room below the [[Bellshrine]].
